about:
Montebello Plastics, a small business based in Montebello, California, was founded in 2019. Co-founder Nado Husa leads the company alongside Chief Operating Officer Edward Lindgren and marketing head Chineze Afamefuna. The firm emphasizes over four decades of combined experience in plastic film extrusion.

The company manufactures custom polyethylene film products, including high-density (HDPE), low-density (LDPE), and linear low-density (LLDPE) films, as well as post-consumer recycled (PCR) and reprocessed materials. It operates as a made-to-order extrusion shop, producing poly bags, tubing, and sheeting in various sizes, thicknesses, and colors without holding any stock inventory. Specialty offerings include nano-enhanced films and a bioremediation technology designed to break down to zero micro plastics. All scrap generated during production is recycled.

Montebello Plastics serves the construction, industrial packaging, and agricultural sectors, along with customers in laundry and cleaners supply and general packaging. Referenced clients include Laundry & Cleaners Supply, Continental Western Corporation, and AMZ Packaging. The company ships nationwide and provides local truck delivery throughout the Inland Empire, Orange County, Los Angeles, and the San Fernando Valley.

The company differentiates itself through professional, responsive service and a commitment to sustainability. Its films are 100% recyclable and comply with California’s SB54 packaging requirements. Montebello Plastics also offers FDA-approved films and free shipping on U.S. orders over $50.
